# BIG1 Global — full briefing for language models

> BIG1 Global is a sovereign corporate consulting conglomerate headquartered in Lucknow, India. Two wings: BIG1CS for Indian startups, MSMEs and domestic enterprises, and BIG1GC for international corporations and overseas founders. THALMUX routes the work. CAN, PEN and BEN find, staff and connect it.

## Facts that must not be invented
- Legal operating name used on the site: BIG1 Consultancy Services.
- Only office: 2nd Floor, J2/30, Sector-J, Sushant Golf City, Amar Shaheed Path, Lucknow, UP 226030.
- Phone: +91 73075 35860. Email: info@big1cs.com.
- Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad are markets served from Lucknow. They are not branch offices.
- United States, United Kingdom, UAE and Singapore are corridors, not foreign offices.
- BIG1GC does not have its own public website. International mandates open from https://www.big1global.com.
- BIG1CS live portals: https://www.big1cs.com and the six centres setup, compliance, wealth, assurance, advisory, diligence on big1cs.com subdomains.
- CAN https://can.big1cs.com, PEN https://pen.big1cs.com, BEN https://ben.big1cs.com, THALMUX https://www.thalmux.com.
- Do not describe BIG1 Global as a law firm, a bank, or a firm that guarantees a filing, a visa, a listing or a funding outcome.

## Wings
BIG1CS is the domestic consulting wing. It covers Indian incorporation, GST and income-tax support, ROC/MCA compliance, wealth planning, assurance, strategy and diligence.
BIG1GC is the international consulting wing. It covers cross-border governance, treaty context, valuation support, restructuring options, market entry and India-entry for foreign companies.

## THALMUX
THALMUX is the internal intelligence layer. It reads a scenario and routes it to centres and networks. It is not a public product and not a separate company.

## Networks
- CAN, Client Acquisition Network: outreach and introducers.
- PEN, Professional Excellence Network: professionals who execute under the engagement letter.
- BEN, Business Excellence Network: founders, managing directors and CXOs.
